newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: BIL says Thistle offer set at 170 pence.
newsitem.headline: BIL says Thistle offer set at 170 pence.

text.p: New Zealand's Brierley Investments Ltd said on Wednesday the float share price for its Thistle Hotels group in Britain had been set at 170 pence per share.
It said its own holding in Thistle would fall from 70 percent to 46 percent after the float.
The price set means Thistle will have a market capitalisation of 1,049.4 million pounds.

The size of the offer is 359.7 million pounds, of which 250 million pounds is from shares issued by the company and the balance from shares sold by BIL and two investment arms of the Government of Singapore which previously owned 30 percent of the group.
Unconditional dealings in Thistle shares are expected to begin on October 9.
Conditional dealing in the shares would start immediately, Thistle said.
The offer price was at the bottom of the range which Thistle said last month it expected to be between 170 and 210 pence.
Retail investors would have the first 1,000 pounds of their applications met in full and 75 percent of the balance.
